So, I work 2 jobs (gotta do something to maintain my Apple addiction, right?), and when I go to my second job I put my watch in the pants I wear for my first job. Well, last night I needed to do some laundry and threw all my clothes in the wash. I went to go to sleep and noticed my watch wasn't on the charging station. I'm looking all over for it and then it hits me. The "oh shit" moment. To the wash I go, filled up with water, spinning around and doing its thing, I start taking everything out feeling all over. Finally I found it in my pants pocket, I take it out, it doesn't come on right away and I'm freaking out. Then it comes on. It took a second because it was in low power mode (hadn't been charged since Friday and I don't wear it on the weekends much because I can't wear it at my second job). I dry it off and then take the band off, poor Milanese. I wrap the band and the watch in paper towels for a few minutes. Throw it on the charger, and here we are, a new day, and it's working just fine.

So, there you have it. Another feature to tick off the ol' Apple Watch list: washing machine proof(ish)
